thought.text: CMS up (719MB available). Now the boards build — it's the last one and its build is now cached from prior runs:

reasoning_content: The CMS is up and running (the build cache from previous builds is helping — check 3 ≈ around 2.5 minutes). 719MB is free — the boards build is going to need about 1.5GB. There's a risk, but let's try it — if the OOM killer fires, I'll retry boards on its own (the app and cms are already built and cached, so their steady-state memory is smaller).

action.command:
cd /workspace
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
rm -f /tmp/s3.log
setsid nohup just serve --apps=boards < /dev/zero > /tmp/s3.log 2>&1 &
echo "boards pid $!"
for i in $(seq 1 9); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:43781/ 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "boards UP at check $i"; break; }
  sleep 55
done
curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "boards direct: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:43781/ 2>/dev/null; free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print "available="$6"MB"}'
